what: Behind the hero, dozens of vertical gradient bars of different widths and lengths (transparent → pale accent → accent → transparent) stand aligned to the bottom, and on open the bars light up in a .035s sequence over 1.5s power2.out, each floating up 1.25rem over 5s (stagger .1s). The title clears from 8px blur over 1s at (bar count − 1) × .025 + .5s, and the body clears over .6s at (bar count − 1) × .025 + .8s — a hero for a finance or research firm, with a serif title condensing over an aurora band

options.[data-fx-part=bars]: Bar container (child) — its direct child is the bar. The user sets bar width and height with --fx-w and --fx-h (container laid out as a grid, bottom-aligned)
options.[data-fx-part=title] · [data-fx-part=tex: (If present) title and body that go from blur to clear
options.delay: Timeline start delay (seconds), default 0 — the original starts after receiving the translated text and ten first-bar images, and measured, the title settles about 2.2s after opening (brand 1.25)
options.dur: Bar lit duration (seconds), default 1.5 — shorten it for screens opened often, like apps
options.gap: Time per bar when counting title slots (s), default .025
options.title-at: Seconds added after that before the title, default .5
options.narrow · narrow-shift: At this width (px) and below, pull the heading by narrow-shift seconds, default 767 · .6
options.text-at: Seconds added to the body after the bar share, default .8 (.3s later than the title)

from.where: index.html .tb-hero — wide screen 43 bars (width 16·32px, height 18~93rem, aligned to the floor of a 43-cell grid) · phone 30 (width 12px, 28~105% of container height). Original front-page.js initMainAnimation + CSS float 5s
